name: git-extended
description: Supercharge Git within VS Code — Blame, CodeLens, Worktrees, Revision Navigation, History, and more

git-extended.currentLine.enabled.markdownDescription: Specifies whether to provide a blame annotation for the current line, by default. Use the `Toggle Line Blame Annotations` command (`git-extended.toggleLineBlame`) to toggle the annotations on and off for the current window

git-extended.currentLine.pullRequests.en.markdownDescription: Specifies whether to provide information about the Pull Request (if any) that introduced the commit in the current line blame annotation. Requires a connection to a supported remote service (e.g. GitHub)

git-extended.currentLine.format.markdownDescription: Specifies the format of the current line blame annotation. See [_Commit Tokens_](https://github.com/byrizki/vscode-git-extended/wiki/Custom-Formatting#commit-tokens) in the Git Extended docs. Date formatting is controlled by the `#git-extended.currentLine.dateFormat#` setting

git-extended.currentLine.uncommittedChan.markdownDescription:
Specifies the uncommitted changes format of the current line blame annotation. See [_Commit Tokens_](https://github.com/byrizki/vscode-git-extended/wiki/Custom-Formatting#commit-tokens) in the Git Extended docs. Date formatting is controlled by the `#git-extended.currentLine.dateFormat#` setting.

**NOTE**: Setting this to an empty string will disable current line blame annotations for uncommitted changes.

git-extended.currentLine.scrollable.markdownDescription: Specifies whether the current line blame annotation can be scrolled into view when it is outside the viewport. **NOTE**: Setting this to `false` will inhibit the hovers from showing over the annotation; Set `#git-extended.hovers.currentLine.over#` to `line` to enable the hovers to show anywhere over the line.

git-extended.currentLine.dateFormat.markdownDescription: Specifies how to format absolute dates (e.g. using the `${date}` token) for the current line blame annotation. See the [Moment.js docs](https://momentjs.com/docs/#/displaying/format/) for supported formats

git-extended.codeLens.enabled.markdownDescription: Specifies whether to provide any Git CodeLens, by default. Use the `Toggle Git CodeLens` command (`git-extended.toggleCodeLens`) to toggle the Git CodeLens on and off for the current window

git-extended.codeLens.authors.enabled.markdownDescription: Specifies whether to provide an _authors_ CodeLens, showing number of authors of the file or code block and the most prominent author (if there is more than one)

git-extended.views.defaultItemLimit.markdownDescription: Specifies the default number of items to show in a view list. Use 0 to specify no limit

Worktrees help you multitask by minimizing context switching between branches, allowing you to easily work on different branches of a repository simultaneously.

You can create multiple working trees, each of which can be opened in individual windows or all together in a single workspace.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Git Extended
walkthroughs.description: Discover and personalize features that supercharge your Git experience

steps.title: Welcome to Git Extended
steps.description: Discover and personalize features that supercharge your Git experience.

steps.title: Get setup quickly
steps.description:
Use the Quick Setup to easily configure frequently used Git Extended features.

[Open Quick Setup](command:git-extended.showWelcomePage?%22quick-setup%22 "Opens the Git Extended Quick Setup")

steps.title: Easily customize every aspect of Git Extended
steps.description:
A rich, interactive settings editor enables seemingly endless customization possibilities.

[Open Settings](command:git-extended.showSettingsPage "Opens the Git Extended Interactive Settings")

steps.title: Multitask with Worktrees
steps.description:
Work on multiple branches simultaneously using native Git worktrees without disrupting your workspace.

[Open Worktrees View](command:git-extended.showWorktreesView)

steps.title: See who made what changes at a glance
steps.description: Current line and status bar blame provide historical context about line changes.

steps.title: View Git authorship via CodeLens
steps.description: CodeLens adds contextual authorship information and links at the top of each file and at the beginning of each block of code.

steps.title: Easily navigate revision history
steps.description: Step backwards and forwards through file revisions to compare changes over time.

steps.title: See more context with file annotations
steps.description: Whole file annotations place visual indicators in the gutter and scroll bar that provide additional context about changes.

steps.title: Explore repositories from the side bar
steps.description:
Rich views expose even more Git functionality in your side bar.

[Set Views Layout](command:git-extended.setViewsLayout)

steps.title: Integrate with Git hosting services
steps.description: Quickly gain insights from pull requests and issues without leaving your editor.

steps.title: Work faster with Git Command Palette
steps.description:
Now you don't have to remember all those Git commands.

[Open Git Command Palette](command:git-extended.gitCommands)

steps.title: Visualize interactive rebase operations
steps.description: A user-friendly interactive rebase editor to easily configure an interactive rebase session

steps.title: Jump to git details from the terminal
steps.description: Using ctrl/cmd+click on autolinks in the integrated terminal will quickly jump to more details for commits, branches, tags, and more.
